summary: Adds an isSameOrigin(a, b) helper to ufo. Semantics are agreed through test cases in test/same-origin.test.ts first; the spec is written, the implementation is not.
narrative: The owner opened one conversation on 2026-11-02 asking for an isSameOrigin(a, b) helper in ufo. They wanted the test cases written first in test/same-origin.test.ts, with no implementation. The agent studied the existing isSamePath conventions and wrote the spec, leaving open questions as pending todos (obs 2, 3). The owner then asked for strict port handling: https://example.com and https://example.com:443 must not match. The agent removed the default-port equivalence cases and moved those pairs into the different-origin set (obs 4, 5). The implementation was left for a later session. In a separate conversation at 22:44 the owner reversed that rule: default ports should match, because their CDN rewrites links with an explicit :443. They said the same-origin tests would be sorted out when the helper is implemented. The spec therefore needs to change back before implementation, and the helper remains unbuilt.

milestones.text: Owner asked for isSameOrigin test cases first, with no implementation yet.
test/same-origin.test.ts created with the semantics as test cases and open questions as pending todos.

Owner reversed the port rule in another conversation: default ports should count as the same origin. Spec update deferred to implementation.
